newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian military helicopter crashes near Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Russian military helicopter crashes near Moscow.

text.p: A Russian military helicopter has crashed near Moscow and there is no word yet on the fate of those aboard, Russian news agencies said on Wednesday.

Itar-Tass news agency quoted military officials as saying that the craft came down on Tuesday afternoon, but rescue workers, hampered by snow and poor visibility, only found the crash site on Wednesday morning.
It was too early to say what happened to the crew or how many people were aboard.
There have been a series of accidents involving Russian-built aircraft this year, including one on Tuesday when a military plane crashed on take-off in northwestern Russia.
Seventeen people, including the commander of the Leningrad military district, were killed in that crash.
